query: UPDATE public.providers SET address = 'No. 8, Adegbola Street, Oshukoti Layout, Oke-Ijebu, Akure, Ondo State', latitude = 7.2450, longitude = 5.2100, updated_at = now() WHERE provider_name ILIKE '%AKINTAN MEMORIAL HOSPITAL%'; UPDATE public.providers SET address = '5, Moses Orimolade Street, Ijapo Estate, Akure, Ondo State', latitude = 7.2550, longitude = 5.2150, updated_at = now() WHERE provider_name ILIKE '%BOLCOM HOSPITAL%'; SELECT id, provider_name, address FROM public.providers WHERE provider_name ILIKE '%AKINTAN%' OR provider_name ILIKE '%BOLCOM%';
